ns2:course.label: Basic Toxicology
ns2:course.description: Emphasizes the physiology, biochemistry and pharmacokinetics of absorption, distribution, metabolism and excretion of topic compounds, drugs, non-nutrient dietary supplements and other compounds foreign to the body. An introduction to the process of cancer, how foreign compounds can initiate, enhance or prevent the process is also included. Same as CB 449, CPSC 433 and ENVS 480. Prerequisite: MCB 350 or MCB 406, or consent of instructor.
